usedFor: PayHere takes the payments, and Eden AI answers with a model through “Create Chat Conversation” after each “Payment Received”.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Received” in PayHere, then “Create Chat Conversation” in Eden AI
bestTemplate.why: A paid order can hand its details to a model that drafts a thank you note.

watchOut: “Create Chat Conversation” only returns the model's reply, so a reply to a customer still needs your approval.
